name: luna-beautiful-codex
description: Browse local Wallpaper Engine media and set in-page Codex backgrounds.

interface.shortDescription: 连接本地 Wallpaper Engine，右下角自主切换 Codex 背景
interface.longDescription: Scans each user's own Steam Wallpaper Engine library, adds a bottom-right in-app picker, restores the selected background automatically, uses original high-resolution media, extracts embedded videos from supported Scene packages, and forces Codex text to white for readability. It never changes the Windows desktop wallpaper.
defaultPrompt: 打开我的 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸选择器
把夜莞设置为 Codex 背景
重置 Codex 自定义背景
